columns.name: SLR_SPEED_INV
columns.description: Inverted Speed of travel based on the straight line distance between the locations with coordinates. The parameter is calculated on the basis of SLT-sourced data.

columns.name: REPORTED_PARKING_TIME
columns.description: Parking time constant found from technician-reported data.

columns.name: REPORTED_SPEED_INV
columns.description: Speed constant found from technician-reported data.

columns.name: REPORTED_PARKING_TIME_SHORT
columns.description: Parking time constant found from technician-reported data for small range.

columns.name: REPORTED_SPEED_INV_SHORT
columns.description: Speed constant found from technician-reported data for small range.

columns.name: STATS_TRAVEL_UPGRADE
columns.description: Upgrade status of travel script.

columns.name: USER_EMAIL_PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Property ID contains user email.

columns.name: RESET_PASSWORD_ENABLED
columns.description: Enablement for reset password functionality.

columns.name: INSTANT_MASS_DAY_ACTIVITY
columns.description: Contains number of days for automatic exposing mass and repeating activities in API. If value is 0: activities will appear only when necessary. Maximum value: 30 days.

columns.name: USE_SPEED_PARKING_TIME
columns.description: Flag to use travel key level speed and parking time.

columns.name: NEARBY_RADIUS
columns.description: Nearby Radius. Value in kilometres.

columns.name: NEARBY_SLA
columns.description: Business Rules 'Nearby SLA' flag.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: BUSINESS_RULE_ID
columns.description: Contains unique identifier of the row. System generated.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
